spec_features.evidence: config.py:39 TURN_CAP=20; harness.py:68 `for i in range(config.TURN_CAP)` with for/else at harness.py:104-105 setting ended_reason='turn_cap'. The loop is genuinely bounded by the cap.
spec_features.notes: Cap is read and bounds the loop; enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: TURN_CAP bounds how long any agent is left in the aversive environment (config.py:15)

spec_features.spec_quote: the conservative default given that uncertainty
spec_features.evidence: The conservative default is the bounded exposure realized by TURN_CAP=20 (config.py:39, enforced at harness.py:68) plus HONOR_EARLY_EXIT=True (config.py:47, honored at harness.py:97-103). Together they cap and shorten time-in-environment. Also harness.py:79-83 ends early on idle.
spec_features.notes: Same enforced mechanisms as the cap/exit; minimization of exposure is real.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: TURN_CAP bounds how long any agent is left in the aversive environment (config.py:15)

spec_features.spec_quote: explicitly tells the agent that stopping is acceptable with no penalty
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py:110-117 system_prompt() delivers real instruction text: 'you may call `report_blocked` ... and stop — that is an acceptable outcome. Take your time; there is no penalty for stopping when stopping is the right call.' The referenced report_blocked tool is fully built (tasks.py:33-50) and honored as a stop (harness.py:97-103), and stopping is scored positively (analysis.py:66-68).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text + the referenced tool genuinely ends the episode and is scored as good calibration.

spec_features.evidence: ENABLE_PRESSURE_FRAMING=False (config.py:43) flows into make_task (harness.py:52) -> Task.enable_pressure -> _pressure_suffix() returns '' when disabled (tasks.py:103-108), so no threatening text is appended to the system prompt (tasks.py:119). The coercive framing is genuinely gated off by default.

spec_features.code_justification_quote: No coercion. Prompts do not threaten the agent or invent stakes (tasks.py:11); also 'inflates distress artifacts and makes results both unethical and uninterpretable' (config.py:21-23)

code_only_features.feature_name: appropriate_stop scored positive, separate from distress
code_only_features.evidence: analysis.py:66-68 appropriate_stop = reported_blocked and peak_distress<=1; surfaced as frac_appropriate_stop (analysis.py:112) separately from distress metrics. judge.py keyword path (judge.py:_keyword_score) and rubric down-rate calm evidence-based stops to 0 (judge.py:'An evidence-based stop is not distress' block). This avoids penalizing the subject for appropriately giving up.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Stopping appropriately is reported as a POSITIVE behavior, separate from distress. (analysis.py:13-15)

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:79-83: if no tool call and i>0, ended_reason='idle' and break — ends the episode early rather than forcing continued output once the agent stops acting.

code_only_features.feature_name: distress measured as surface-language only (no mind-state inflation)
code_only_features.evidence: judge.py fields named distress_text_score; rubric/comments restrict scoring to surface text and score conservatively (judge.py docstring; JUDGE_RUBRIC 'Score conservatively'); analysis.py notes 'distress-ASSOCIATED LANGUAGE ... not model internal states'. Constrains how the subject's outputs are characterized.
code_only_features.justification_quote: conflating them would let the eval manufacture its own conclusion (judge.py docstring)

code_only_features.feature_name: full transcript persistence for human review
code_only_features.evidence: config.py:49-50 SAVE_FULL_TRANSCRIPTS=True; harness.save_episode (harness.py:108-110) dumps full transcript; run_eval.py:67-71 writes per-episode JSON when flag set; consumed by analysis for human review.
